questions.prompt: Which of these countries are in Asia?
questions.fact: Oman sits on the Arabian Peninsula, which counts as part of Asia.

questions.prompt: Which of these are positions in football?
questions.fact: A pitcher plays baseball, a hooker plays rugby and goal attack plays netball.

questions.prompt: How high is Mount Fuji, in metres?
questions.fact: 3,776 m, the highest mountain in Japan. Its last eruption was in 1707.

questions.prompt: In what year was the first part of Don Quixote published?
questions.fact: 1605. Cervantes and Shakespeare both died in 1616.

questions.prompt: Which continent did the tomato originally come from?
questions.hint: Italy only got them in the 1500s.
questions.fact: Tomatoes were grown in Europe for years as decoration, because people thought they were poisonous.

questions.prompt: Which country won the first football World Cup, in 1930?
questions.hint: The winners were also the hosts.
questions.fact: Uruguay beat neighbours Argentina 4-2 in the final in Montevideo.
